text: Ive been trying to get through on the phone for nearly an hour so Im messaging instead. My daughter is 8 and has chickenpox, started yesterday. Spots everywhere and she is scratching like mad, we've done the calamine. Her temp is 39.7 which seems realy high to me, thats why im contacting you. Otherwise she is herself, watching her tablet and moaning about the itching. Before anyone asks the same questions again, her neck is fine, she can look down at her toes no problem, and her colour is normal, lips normal, nothing blue or pale. I just want to know if 39.7 is ok with chickenpox or if I need to take her somewhere becuase nobody has actually told me anything yet
